items.t: Prospect Enhanced Yield Fund Announces November 2026 Distribution at 11.7% Annualized Rate
items.sum: NEW YORK, Nov. 24, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Prospect Enhanced Yield Fund (“PENF” or the “Fund”) announced today that the Fund’s Board of Directors has declared a monthly cash shareholder distribution for November 2026.
